# 🧱 EV3 beginner examples: Pathfinder 8-way

[🔙 Back to the Pathfinder 8-way product page](/en/sensors/line8/index.md)

This page has 6 examples for people who have **never written a program**: every example comes with a ready-made program file you can download and run, plus a plain-language step-by-step explanation. Start with example 1 and work through in order.

## Before you start

1. Use the **EV3 edition** of the sensor (RJ12 plug), plugged into **port 1** of the EV3.
2. **Turn the EV3 on first, then plug in the sensor.** If the number never changes, unplug the sensor and plug it back in.
3. Examples that drive use the LEGO Education base robot: **left wheel motor on B, right wheel motor on C**.
4. The sensor shows up on the EV3 as an "Infrared Sensor". That is normal: read its values with the infrared sensor blocks.

**Every example comes in 5 software versions; pick the one you use:** (examples marked "Pybricks / EV3 MicroPython / clev3r only" come in those 3 versions only, because the EV3-G and Classroom blocks cannot read that mode)

| Software | Who it suits | How to open the example file |
|---|---|---|
| **EV3-G (official software)** | School computer labs, WRO teams (the most common in Taiwan) | Download the `.ev3` file, choose "File → Open Project" in the EV3 software, then "Download and Run" at the bottom right. |
| **EV3 Classroom** | First time with EV3, want the same blocks as SPIKE | Download the `.lmsp` file, choose "Open" on the EV3 Classroom home screen, connect the EV3 and press "Download and Run" at the bottom right. |
| **Pybricks v4** | Want to learn typed code, works in the browser | Open [code.pybricks.com](https://code.pybricks.com) in Chrome; the EV3 needs the Pybricks firmware first (currently Beta). Drag the `.py` file into the editor and press Run. |
| **EV3 MicroPython v2.0** | Already using the official LEGO EV3 MicroPython | Use the official LEGO "EV3 MicroPython" microSD boot card + the VS Code extension; paste the program into `main.py` and press F5 to download and run. |
| **clev3r** | Already using clev3r (EV3 Basic) | Open the `.bp` file in clev3r, press "Compile and download", then run it from the `MBC_` folder in the EV3 file browser. |

## Before you start: calibrate (once)

The Pathfinder has to "learn" the black and white of your mat before its numbers are right. Calibration is stored in the sensor and survives power-off.

1. Plug in the sensor and turn the EV3 on (the sensor lights come on).
2. **Press and release** the calibration button on the sensor (do not hold it down; holding it keeps restarting calibration).
3. When the green calibration light comes on, **within 5 seconds** sweep the sensor back and forth between the black line and the white mat a few times, so all 8 channels see both black and white.
4. Green light off = calibration done.

**How do I know it worked?** Before running example 4, use example 1 to watch the line position: 0 with the line in the centre, negative when moved left, positive when moved right.

## The 4 values used on this page

| Name | Range | Where it comes from |
|---|---|---|
| **Line position** | -8 ~ +8, 0 = line in the centre | Mode 0 |
| **Line width (channels on the black line)** | 0 ~ 8, 0 = no line | Mode 2, value 2 |
| **Line position (fine)** | -100 ~ +100, 0 = line in the centre | Mode 2, value 1 |
| **Line bitmap** | 0 ~ 255: bit0 = channel 1 (far left) … bit7 = channel 8, 1 = that channel is on the line | Mode 3, value 1 (Pybricks / EV3 MicroPython / clev3r only) |

> [!TIP]
> When the line disappears, the "line position" **keeps the last value it saw**; it does not go back to 0. So to check "is there a line", always look at **whether the line width is 0**.

## Example 1: See where the line is

**What this example does:** Put the sensor over the black line and the EV3 screen shows a number telling you where the line is. This is step one of every line-following program: learn to "read the number".

**What you need:**

- EV3 brick + Education base robot (left wheel on B, right wheel on C)
- Pathfinder 8-way (EV3 edition, RJ12 plug)
- A white mat with a black line (about 2 cm wide)

**How to connect:** Pathfinder 8-way in port 1, mounted under the front of the robot about 1 cm above the ground, facing straight down.

**Download the program (pick your software):**

[⬇ EV3-G (official software)](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex01_show_position.ev3) ｜ [⬇ EV3 Classroom](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex01_show_position.lmsp) ｜ [⬇ Pybricks v4](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex01_show_position_pybricks_v4.py) ｜ [⬇ EV3 MicroPython v2.0](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex01_show_position_ev3micropython_v2.py) ｜ [⬇ clev3r](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex01_show_position.bp)

<details><summary>Pybricks v4 code</summary>

```python
# ============================================================
# 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 01：看看線在哪裡
# 軟體：Pybricks v4（用 Chrome 打開 https://code.pybricks.com ，EV3 版目前是 Beta）
# 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔
# 這個範例會做什麼：把感應器放在黑線上，EV3 螢幕會顯示一個數字告訴你線在哪裡。這是所有循線程式的第一步：先學會「讀數字」。
# ============================================================

from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.iodevices import LUMPDevice
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Color
from pybricks.tools import wait

ev3 = EV3Brick()
sensor = LUMPDevice(Port.S1)       # 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔


def read_pos():
    # 線的位置：-8 ~ +8，0＝線在正中間
    return sensor.read(0)[0]


# ---------- 程式從這裡開始 ----------
# 先把螢幕清乾淨
ev3.screen.clear()
# 下面的動作一直重複
while True:
    # 讀取線的位置，顯示在螢幕第 1 行
    ev3.screen.draw_text(0, 0, "POS " + str(read_pos()) + "      ", Color.BLACK, Color.WHITE)
    # 等 0.1 秒再讀下一次，數字才不會閃太快
    wait(100)
```

**Step by step:**

1. Clear the screen first
1. Repeat the steps below forever
   - Read the line position and show it on screen row 1
   - Wait 0.1 s before the next read so the number does not flicker

**What you should see:** With the black line in the middle of the sensor the screen shows 0; move the line left and the number goes negative, move it right and it goes positive, up to ±8 at the edges (left/right as seen standing behind the robot, facing forward).

**FAQ:**

- **The line is gone but the number stays at the last value?** That is normal: when the line leaves the sensor, the position stays where it was last seen. To detect "line lost", use the line width from example 4 (width = 0).
- **The number never changes?** Check that the sensor light is on and the cable is seated. Turn the EV3 on before plugging in the sensor, or unplug and plug it back in.
- **The robot steers the wrong way and gets worse?** Swap the "+" and "−" in the program (swap the left/right wheel corrections), or check that the left wheel is on B and the right wheel on C.

## Example 2: Three-way line following: left, right, straight

**What this example does:** Use "if … then … else" to make the robot follow the black line: turn left when the line is to the left, turn right when it is to the right, go straight when it is in the middle.

**What you need:**

- EV3 brick + Education base robot (left wheel on B, right wheel on C)
- Pathfinder 8-way (EV3 edition, RJ12 plug)
- A white mat with a black line (about 2 cm wide)

**How to connect:** Pathfinder 8-way in port 1, mounted under the front of the robot about 1 cm above the ground, facing straight down.

**Download the program (pick your software):**

[⬇ EV3-G (official software)](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex02_three_way.ev3) ｜ [⬇ EV3 Classroom](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex02_three_way.lmsp) ｜ [⬇ Pybricks v4](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex02_three_way_pybricks_v4.py) ｜ [⬇ EV3 MicroPython v2.0](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex02_three_way_ev3micropython_v2.py) ｜ [⬇ clev3r](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex02_three_way.bp)

<details><summary>Pybricks v4 code</summary>

```python
# ============================================================
# 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 02：三段式循線：偏左、偏右、直走
# 軟體：Pybricks v4（用 Chrome 打開 https://code.pybricks.com ，EV3 版目前是 Beta）
# 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔；左輪馬達接 B、右輪馬達接 C
# 這個範例會做什麼：用「如果…就…否則…」讓車子沿著黑線走：線偏左就往左轉，線偏右就往右轉，在中間就直走。
# ============================================================

from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.ev3devices import Motor
from pybricks.iodevices import LUMPDevice
from pybricks.parameters import Port
from pybricks.tools import wait

ev3 = EV3Brick()
sensor = LUMPDevice(Port.S1)       # 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔
left_motor = Motor(Port.B)        # 左輪
right_motor = Motor(Port.C)       # 右輪


def read_pos():
    # 線的位置：-8 ~ +8，0＝線在正中間
    return sensor.read(0)[0]


# ---------- 程式從這裡開始 ----------
# 一直重複檢查線的位置
while True:
    # 如果線的位置小於 -2（偏左）
    if read_pos() < (-2):
        # 線偏左：左輪慢、右輪快，車子往左修
        left_motor.dc(10)
        right_motor.dc(40)
    # 否則，如果線的位置大於 2（偏右）
    elif read_pos() > 2:
        # 線偏右：左輪快、右輪慢，車子往右修
        left_motor.dc(40)
        right_motor.dc(10)
    else:
        # 線在中間：兩輪一樣快，直直走
        left_motor.dc(30)
        right_motor.dc(30)
```

</details>

```python
#!/usr/bin/env pybricks-micropython
# ============================================================
# 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 02：三段式循線：偏左、偏右、直走
# 軟體：樂高官方 EV3 MicroPython v2.0（microSD 開機卡＋VS Code「LEGO MINDSTORMS EV3 MicroPython」擴充套件）
# 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔；左輪馬達接 B、右輪馬達接 C
# 這個範例會做什麼：用「如果…就…否則…」讓車子沿著黑線走：線偏左就往左轉，線偏右就往右轉，在中間就直走。
# ============================================================

from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.ev3devices import Motor
from pybricks.iodevices import Ev3devSensor
from pybricks.parameters import Port
from pybricks.tools import wait

ev3 = EV3Brick()
sensor = Ev3devSensor(Port.S1)     # 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔
left_motor = Motor(Port.B)        # 左輪
right_motor = Motor(Port.C)       # 右輪


def read_pos():
    # 線的位置：-8 ~ +8，0＝線在正中間
    return sensor.read('IR-PROX')[0]


# ---------- 程式從這裡開始 ----------
# 一直重複檢查線的位置
while True:
    # 如果線的位置小於 -2（偏左）
    if read_pos() < (-2):
        # 線偏左：左輪慢、右輪快，車子往左修
        left_motor.dc(10)
        right_motor.dc(40)
    # 否則，如果線的位置大於 2（偏右）
    elif read_pos() > 2:
        # 線偏右：左輪快、右輪慢，車子往右修
        left_motor.dc(40)
        right_motor.dc(10)
    else:
        # 線在中間：兩輪一樣快，直直走
        left_motor.dc(30)
        right_motor.dc(30)
```

```vb
' 軟體：clev3r
' 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔；左輪馬達接 B、右輪馬達接 C
' 這個範例會做什麼：用「如果…就…否則…」讓車子沿著黑線走：線偏左就往左轉，線偏右就往右轉，在中間就直走。
' 讀值：pos＝線的位置（-8 ~ +8，0＝線在正中間）

folder "prjs" "MBC_line8_ex02"

Sensor.SetMode(1, 0)
LCD.Clear()

' 一直重複檢查線的位置
While "True"
  ' 如果線的位置小於 -2（偏左）
  If Sensor.ReadRawValue(1, 0) < (-2) Then
    ' 線偏左：左輪慢、右輪快，車子往左修
    Motor.StartPower("B", 10)
    Motor.StartPower("C", 40)
  ' 否則，如果線的位置大於 2（偏右）
  ElseIf Sensor.ReadRawValue(1, 0) > 2 Then
    ' 線偏右：左輪快、右輪慢，車子往右修
    Motor.StartPower("B", 40)
    Motor.StartPower("C", 10)
  Else
    ' 線在中間：兩輪一樣快，直直走
    Motor.StartPower("B", 30)
    Motor.StartPower("C", 30)
  EndIf
EndWhile
```

</details>

**Step by step:**

1. Keep checking the line position
   - If the line position is less than -2 (line is to the left)
      - Line to the left: left wheel slow, right wheel fast, the robot steers left
      - Otherwise:
         - Otherwise, if the line position is greater than 2 (line is to the right)
            - Line to the right: left wheel fast, right wheel slow, the robot steers right
            - Otherwise:
               - Line in the centre: both wheels the same speed, go straight

**What you should see:** The robot wobbles left and right along the black line. On sharp bends it may run off; try lowering 40 and changing 10 to 0.

**FAQ:**

- **The number never changes?** Check that the sensor light is on and the cable is seated. Turn the EV3 on before plugging in the sensor, or unplug and plug it back in.
- **The robot steers the wrong way and gets worse?** Swap the "+" and "−" in the program (swap the left/right wheel corrections), or check that the left wheel is on B and the right wheel on C.

## Example 3: Proportional line following: the further off, the harder it turns

**What this example does:** Three-way line following keeps wobbling. This example uses "line position × a number" as the steering power: a little off means a little turn, a lot off means a big turn, so the robot drives more smoothly.

**What you need:**

- EV3 brick + Education base robot (left wheel on B, right wheel on C)
- Pathfinder 8-way (EV3 edition, RJ12 plug)
- A white mat with a black line (about 2 cm wide)

**How to connect:** Pathfinder 8-way in port 1, mounted under the front of the robot about 1 cm above the ground, facing straight down.

**Download the program (pick your software):**

[⬇ EV3-G (official software)](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex03_proportional.ev3) ｜ [⬇ EV3 Classroom](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex03_proportional.lmsp) ｜ [⬇ Pybricks v4](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex03_proportional_pybricks_v4.py) ｜ [⬇ EV3 MicroPython v2.0](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex03_proportional_ev3micropython_v2.py) ｜ [⬇ clev3r](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex03_proportional.bp)

<details><summary>Pybricks v4 code</summary>

```python
# ============================================================
# 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 03：比例循線：偏越多、轉越多
# 軟體：Pybricks v4（用 Chrome 打開 https://code.pybricks.com ，EV3 版目前是 Beta）
# 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔；左輪馬達接 B、右輪馬達接 C
# 這個範例會做什麼：三段式循線會一直搖擺。這個範例把「線的位置 × 一個數字」當成轉彎的力量：偏一點就轉一點、偏很多就轉很多，車子會走得更順。
# ============================================================

from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.ev3devices import Motor
from pybricks.iodevices import LUMPDevice
from pybricks.parameters import Port
from pybricks.tools import wait

ev3 = EV3Brick()
sensor = LUMPDevice(Port.S1)       # 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔
left_motor = Motor(Port.B)        # 左輪
right_motor = Motor(Port.C)       # 右輪


def read_pos():
    # 線的位置：-8 ~ +8，0＝線在正中間
    return sensor.read(0)[0]


# ---------- 程式從這裡開始 ----------
# 一直重複
while True:
    # 轉彎力量 turn ＝ 線的位置 × 4
    turn = read_pos() * 4
    # 左輪＝30＋turn、右輪＝30－turn：線偏哪邊，車子就往哪邊修
    left_motor.dc(30 + turn)
    right_motor.dc(30 - turn)
```

```python
# ============================================================
# 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 03：比例循線：偏越多、轉越多
# 軟體：樂高官方 EV3 MicroPython v2.0（microSD 開機卡＋VS Code「LEGO MINDSTORMS EV3 MicroPython」擴充套件）
# 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔；左輪馬達接 B、右輪馬達接 C
# 這個範例會做什麼：三段式循線會一直搖擺。這個範例把「線的位置 × 一個數字」當成轉彎的力量：偏一點就轉一點、偏很多就轉很多，車子會走得更順。
# ============================================================

from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.ev3devices import Motor
from pybricks.iodevices import Ev3devSensor
from pybricks.parameters import Port
from pybricks.tools import wait

sensor = Ev3devSensor(Port.S1)     # 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔
left_motor = Motor(Port.B)        # 左輪
right_motor = Motor(Port.C)       # 右輪


def read_pos():
    # 線的位置：-8 ~ +8，0＝線在正中間
    return sensor.read('IR-PROX')[0]


# ---------- 程式從這裡開始 ----------
# 一直重複
while True:
    # 轉彎力量 turn ＝ 線的位置 × 4
    turn = read_pos() * 4
    # 左輪＝30＋turn、右輪＝30－turn：線偏哪邊，車子就往哪邊修
    left_motor.dc(30 + turn)
    right_motor.dc(30 - turn)
```

**Step by step:**

1. Repeat forever
   - Steering power turn = line position × 4
   - Left wheel = 30 + turn, right wheel = 30 − turn: the robot steers towards the line

**What you should see:** The robot follows the black line more smoothly than in example 2. The number 4 is the "proportional gain": too big and it swings left and right, too small and it cannot make the bends. Tune it yourself.

**FAQ:**

- **It keeps swinging even on a straight line?** Lower 4 a little (for example 2).
- **The number never changes?** Check that the sensor light is on and the cable is seated. Turn the EV3 on before plugging in the sensor, or unplug and plug it back in.
- **The robot steers the wrong way and gets worse?** Swap the "+" and "−" in the program (swap the left/right wheel corrections), or check that the left wheel is on B and the right wheel on C.

---

## Example 4: Stop at a crossing

**What this example does:** The sensor also tells you "how many channels see the black line" (line width). Normally that is 2~3; at a crossing it suddenly jumps. This example follows the line while watching the width, and stops with a beep when it is 6 or more.

**What you need:**

- EV3 brick + Education base robot (left wheel on B, right wheel on C)
- Pathfinder 8-way (EV3 edition, RJ12 plug)
- A black-line mat with crossings

**How to connect:** Pathfinder 8-way in port 1, mounted under the front of the robot about 1 cm above the ground, facing straight down.

**Download the program (pick your software):**

[⬇ EV3-G (official software)](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex04_stop_at_cross.ev3) ｜ [⬇ EV3 Classroom](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex04_stop_at_cross.lmsp) ｜ [⬇ Pybricks v4](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex04_stop_at_cross_pybricks_v4.py) ｜ [⬇ EV3 MicroPython v2.0](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex04_stop_at_cross_ev3micropython_v2.py) ｜ [⬇ clev3r](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex04_stop_at_cross.bp)

```python
# ============================================================
# 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 04：碰到十字路口就停車
# 軟體：Pybricks v4（用 Chrome 打開 https://code.pybricks.com ，EV3 版目前是 Beta）
# 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔；左輪馬達接 B、右輪馬達接 C
# 這個範例會做什麼：感應器還會告訴你「壓到黑線的格數」（線寬）。平常只有 2~3 格，到十字路口會一下子變很多。這個範例邊循線邊看線寬，大於等於 6 就停車並嗶一聲。
# ============================================================

from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.ev3devices import Motor
from pybricks.iodevices import LUMPDevice
from pybricks.parameters import Port
from pybricks.tools import wait

ev3 = EV3Brick()
sensor = LUMPDevice(Port.S1)       # 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔
left_motor = Motor(Port.B)        # 左輪
right_motor = Motor(Port.C)       # 右輪


def read_width():
    # 線的寬度（壓到黑線的格數）：0 ~ 8，0＝看不到線
    return sensor.read(2)[1]


def read_pos100():
    # 線的位置（細）：-100 ~ +100，0＝線在正中間
    return sensor.read(2)[0]


# ---------- 程式從這裡開始 ----------
# 一直循線，直到線寬大於等於 6（到路口了）
while not (read_width() >= 6):
    # 轉彎力量 turn ＝ 線的位置（-100~100）× 0.3
    turn = read_pos100() * 0.3
    # 一樣用比例循線往前走，速度放慢到 25
    left_motor.dc(25 + turn)
    right_motor.dc(25 - turn)
# 停車
left_motor.brake()
right_motor.brake()
# 嗶一聲告訴你到了
ev3.speaker.beep()
```

</details>

1. Stop
1. Beep to tell you it arrived

**FAQ:**

- **It stops before the crossing?** Bends can also widen the line; raise 6 a little.
- **It does not stop at the crossing?** Show the line width the way example 1 does, read the real value at the crossing, then change 6 in the program.
- **The number never changes?** Check that the sensor light is on and the cable is seated. Turn the EV3 on before plugging in the sensor, or unplug and plug it back in.
- **The robot steers the wrong way and gets worse?** Swap the "+" and "−" in the program (swap the left/right wheel corrections), or check that the left wheel is on B and the right wheel on C.

## Example 5: Count crossings: stop at the 3rd one

**What this example does:** Competitions often say "drive to the Nth crossing". This example counts crossings with a variable count and uses another variable onCross to remember "am I on a crossing right now", so one crossing is not counted many times.

**What you need:**

- EV3 brick + Education base robot (left wheel on B, right wheel on C)
- Pathfinder 8-way (EV3 edition, RJ12 plug)
- A black-line mat with 3 or more crossings

**How to connect:** Pathfinder 8-way in port 1, mounted under the front of the robot about 1 cm above the ground, facing straight down.

**Download the program (pick your software):**

[⬇ EV3-G (official software)](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex05_count_cross.ev3) ｜ [⬇ EV3 Classroom](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex05_count_cross.lmsp) ｜ [⬇ Pybricks v4](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex05_count_cross_pybricks_v4.py) ｜ [⬇ EV3 MicroPython v2.0](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex05_count_cross_ev3micropython_v2.py) ｜ [⬇ clev3r](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex05_count_cross.bp)

<details><summary>Pybricks v4 code</summary>

```python
# ============================================================
# 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 05：數路口：第 3 個路口停車
# 軟體：Pybricks v4（用 Chrome 打開 https://code.pybricks.com ，EV3 版目前是 Beta）
# 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔；左輪馬達接 B、右輪馬達接 C
# 這個範例會做什麼：比賽常常要「走到第幾個路口」。這個範例用一個變數 count 數路口，用另一個變數 onCross 記住「現在是不是正壓在路口上」，避免同一個路口被數很多次。
# ============================================================

from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.ev3devices import Motor
from pybricks.iodevices import LUMPDevice
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Color
from pybricks.tools import wait

ev3 = EV3Brick()
sensor = LUMPDevice(Port.S1)       # 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔
left_motor = Motor(Port.B)        # 左輪
right_motor = Motor(Port.C)       # 右輪


def read_pos100():
    # 線的位置（細）：-100 ~ +100，0＝線在正中間
    return sensor.read(2)[0]


def read_width():
    # 線的寬度（壓到黑線的格數）：0 ~ 8，0＝看不到線
    return sensor.read(2)[1]


# ---------- 程式從這裡開始 ----------
# 路口數 count 從 0 開始
count = 0
# onCross＝0 代表「現在不在路口上」
onCross = 0
# 一直循線，直到數滿 3 個路口
while not (count >= 3):
    # 比例循線：turn ＝ 線的位置 × 0.3
    turn = read_pos100() * 0.3
    # 左輪＝25＋turn、右輪＝25－turn
    left_motor.dc(25 + turn)
    right_motor.dc(25 - turn)
    # 如果線寬大於等於 6（壓在路口上）
    if read_width() >= 6:
        # 而且剛剛還不在路口上
        if onCross == 0:
            # 剛壓到新路口：count 加 1
            count = count + 1
            # 記住「正在路口上」，同一個路口不要再數
            onCross = 1
            # 嗶一聲
            ev3.speaker.beep()
    else:
        # 離開路口了：onCross 改回 0，準備數下一個
        onCross = 0
    # 螢幕顯示已經數到第幾個路口
    ev3.screen.draw_text(0, 0, "COUNT " + str(count) + "      ", Color.BLACK, Color.WHITE)
# 停車
left_motor.brake()
right_motor.brake()
```

</details>

1. Keep following the line until 3 crossings have been counted
   - Proportional line following: turn = line position × 0.3
   - Left wheel = 25 + turn, right wheel = 25 − turn
   - If the line width is 6 or more (on a crossing)
      - and we were not on a crossing a moment ago
         - Just reached a new crossing: add 1 to count
         - Remember "on a crossing" so the same crossing is not counted again
         - Beep
      - Otherwise:
         - Left the crossing: set onCross back to 0, ready for the next one
   - Show how many crossings have been counted
1. Stop

**What you should see:** Every crossing beeps once and adds 1 on the screen; the robot stops at the 3rd crossing. Change the 3 to stop at a different crossing.

**FAQ:**

- **One crossing is counted twice?** Happens when the black line at the crossing is damaged or shiny. Slow the speed 25 down or raise the width threshold.
- **The number never changes?** Check that the sensor light is on and the cable is seated. Turn the EV3 on before plugging in the sensor, or unplug and plug it back in.
- **The robot steers the wrong way and gets worse?** Swap the "+" and "−" in the program (swap the left/right wheel corrections), or check that the left wheel is on B and the right wheel on C.

---

## Example 6: Line bitmap: draw an LED ruler on the screen

> **Pybricks v4 / EV3 MicroPython v2.0 / clev3r only** (the EV3-G and Classroom blocks cannot read this mode)

**What this example does:** Mode 3 sends the "line bitmap": 8 bits, one per channel, 1 when that channel is on the line. This example draws it as a ruler (# = on the line, . = not), just like the LEDs on the sensor, so you can see at a glance which channels see the line and whether there is a fork.

**What you need:**

- Pathfinder 8-way (EV3 edition, firmware v4.0 or later)
- EV3 brick
- A white mat with a black line

**How to connect:** Pathfinder 8-way in port 1, mounted under the front of the robot about 1 cm above the ground, facing straight down.

**Download the program (pick your software):**

[⬇ Pybricks v4](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex06_bitmap_ruler_pybricks_v4.py) ｜ [⬇ EV3 MicroPython v2.0](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex06_bitmap_ruler_ev3micropython_v2.py) ｜ [⬇ clev3r](/examples/line8/ev3_beginner/ex06_bitmap_ruler.bp)

(The code is the example; no screenshot needed.)

<details><summary>Pybricks v4 code</summary>

```python
# ============================================================
# 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 06：壓線位元圖：在螢幕上畫一把 LED 尺
# 軟體：Pybricks v4（用 Chrome 打開 https://code.pybricks.com ，EV3 版目前是 Beta）
# 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔
# 這個範例會做什麼：模式 3 送出「壓線位元圖」：8 個位元，每一路壓到線就是 1。這個範例把它畫成一把尺（# ＝壓到線、. ＝沒壓到），跟感應器上的 LED 一樣，一眼就看出線在哪幾路、有沒有分岔。
# ============================================================

from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.iodevices import LUMPDevice
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Color
from pybricks.tools import wait

ev3 = EV3Brick()
sensor = LUMPDevice(Port.S1)       # 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔


def read_bitmap():
    # 壓線位元圖：0 ~ 255：bit0＝第 1 路（最左）… bit7＝第 8 路，1＝那一路壓到線
    return sensor.read(3)[0] & 0xFFFF


# ---------- 程式從這裡開始 ----------
# 清除螢幕
ev3.screen.clear()
# 一直重複
while True:
    # 第 1 行畫尺：8 格，最左是第 1 路，# ＝壓到線、. ＝沒壓到
    bits_value = read_bitmap()
    bits_text = ""
    for b in range(8):
        if (bits_value // (2 ** b)) % 2 == 1:   # 第 b 個位元是 1
            bits_text = bits_text + "#"
        else:
            bits_text = bits_text + "."
    ev3.screen.draw_text(0, 0, "LINE " + bits_text + "  ", Color.BLACK, Color.WHITE)
    # 第 2 行顯示位元圖的數字（第 1 路＝1、第 2 路＝2、第 3 路＝4…相加）
    ev3.screen.draw_text(0, 16, "BITS " + str(read_bitmap()) + "      ", Color.BLACK, Color.WHITE)
    # 等 0.1 秒
    wait(100)
```

</details>

```python
#!/usr/bin/env pybricks-micropython
# ============================================================
# 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 06：壓線位元圖：在螢幕上畫一把 LED 尺
# 軟體：樂高官方 EV3 MicroPython v2.0（microSD 開機卡＋VS Code「LEGO MINDSTORMS EV3 MicroPython」擴充套件）
# 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔
# 這個範例會做什麼：模式 3 送出「壓線位元圖」：8 個位元，每一路壓到線就是 1。這個範例把它畫成一把尺（# ＝壓到線、. ＝沒壓到），跟感應器上的 LED 一樣，一眼就看出線在哪幾路、有沒有分岔。
# ============================================================

from pybricks.hubs import EV3Brick
from pybricks.iodevices import Ev3devSensor
from pybricks.parameters import Port, Color
from pybricks.tools import wait

ev3 = EV3Brick()
sensor = Ev3devSensor(Port.S1)     # 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔


def read_bitmap():
    # 壓線位元圖：0 ~ 255：bit0＝第 1 路（最左）… bit7＝第 8 路，1＝那一路壓到線
    return sensor.read('IR-REM-A')[0] & 0xFFFF


# ---------- 程式從這裡開始 ----------
# 清除螢幕
ev3.screen.clear()
# 一直重複
while True:
    # 第 1 行畫尺：8 格，最左是第 1 路，# ＝壓到線、. ＝沒壓到
    bits_value = read_bitmap()
    bits_text = ""
    for b in range(8):
        if (bits_value // (2 ** b)) % 2 == 1:   # 第 b 個位元是 1
            bits_text = bits_text + "#"
        else:
            bits_text = bits_text + "."
    ev3.screen.draw_text(0, 0, "LINE " + bits_text + "  ", Color.BLACK, Color.WHITE)
    # 第 2 行顯示位元圖的數字（第 1 路＝1、第 2 路＝2、第 3 路＝4…相加）
    ev3.screen.draw_text(0, 16, "BITS " + str(read_bitmap()) + "      ", Color.BLACK, Color.WHITE)
    # 等 0.1 秒
    wait(100)
```

<details><summary>clev3r code</summary>

```vb
' ============================================================
' 循行者 8 路循線感應器 EV3 新手範例 06：壓線位元圖：在螢幕上畫一把 LED 尺
' 軟體：clev3r
' 接法：循行者 8 路插 1 號孔；左輪馬達接 B、右輪馬達接 C
' 這個範例會做什麼：模式 3 送出「壓線位元圖」：8 個位元，每一路壓到線就是 1。這個範例把它畫成一把尺（# ＝壓到線、. ＝沒壓到），跟感應器上的 LED 一樣，一眼就看出線在哪幾路、有沒有分岔。
' 讀值：bitmap＝壓線位元圖（0 ~ 255：bit0＝第 1 路（最左）… bit7＝第 8 路，1＝那一路壓到線）
' ============================================================
folder "prjs" "MBC_line8_ex06"

' 循行者 8 路插 1 號孔，使用模式 3
Sensor.SetMode(1, 3)
LCD.Clear()

' 清除螢幕
LCD.Clear()
' 一直重複
While "True"
  ' 第 1 行畫尺：8 格，最左是第 1 路，# ＝壓到線、. ＝沒壓到
  bitsValue = Math.Remainder(Sensor.ReadRawValue(1, 0) + 65536, 65536)
  bitsText = ""
  For b = 0 To 7
    If Math.Remainder(Math.Floor(bitsValue / Math.Power(2, b)), 2) = 1 Then
      bitsText = Text.Append(bitsText, "#")
    Else
      bitsText = Text.Append(bitsText, ".")
    EndIf
  EndFor
  LCD.Text(1, 0, 0, 1, "LINE " + bitsText + "  ")
  ' 第 2 行顯示位元圖的數字（第 1 路＝1、第 2 路＝2、第 3 路＝4…相加）
  LCD.Text(1, 0, 16, 1, "BITS " + Math.Remainder(Sensor.ReadRawValue(1, 0) + 65536, 65536) + "      ")
  ' 等 0.1 秒
  Program.Delay(100)
EndWhile
```

</details>

**Step by step:**

1. Clear the screen
1. Repeat forever
   - Row 1 draws the ruler: 8 cells, channel 1 on the far left, # = on the line, . = not
   - Row 2 shows the bitmap as a number (channel 1 = 1, channel 2 = 2, channel 3 = 4 … added up)
   - Wait 0.1 s

**What you should see:** Put the sensor over the black line: 2~3 # marks follow the line along the ruler; at a crossing the whole row turns into #; with no line it is all dots. The number is the sum of 1, 2, 4, 8 … for the channels on the line, for example channels 1 and 2 = 3.

**FAQ:**

- **The ruler is mirrored compared with the sensor LEDs?** The ruler is seen from behind the robot (far left = channel 1); the LEDs may look mirrored when viewed from above.
- **The number stays at 0 or never changes?** This mode needs sensor firmware v4.0 (2026-10) or later; update older firmware first.
- **Why is there no EV3-G / Classroom version?** This example uses a new mode (firmware v4, 2026-10). The EV3-G and Classroom infrared blocks cannot read it; only Pybricks, EV3 MicroPython and clev3r can.
- **The number never changes?** Check that the sensor light is on and the cable is seated. Turn the EV3 on before plugging in the sensor, or unplug and plug it back in.
